artworks.title: Shipwreck of the Greek Fleet on the Voyage Home from Troy
artworks.description: Nationalmuseum Stockholm: the Returns as wreckage — storm and reef standing in for the Nostoi's catalogue of captains who never came home clean.

popCulture.title: Nostoi
popCulture.creator: Epic Cycle
popCulture.description: The lost Returns epic — Agamemnon murdered, Menelaus storm-driven, Nestor safe — the cycle that made homecoming a genre.

popCulture.title: Nostos
popCulture.description: Greek for the hero's return — the word that still names longing for home after war and wandering.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries stages one strand of the Returns — Odysseus' nostos while other captains' homecomings end in murder and storm.
